summary: Pandemic is a cooperative game where players work together as disease specialists, traveling the globe to treat infections and research cures before outbreaks cascade out of control. It's a tense, tightly-timed puzzle of resource and action management with a shared board that can spiral into losses if the infection deck turns against you.
praised: Iconic, accessible introduction to cooperative gaming
Strong tension and sense of shared crisis
criticised: Can suffer from a dominant 'alpha player' quarterbacking the group
Difficulty can swing heavily on card draw luck
Loses tension after many plays once strategies are known

interaction.kind: cooperative play on one shared board
interaction.detail: All players act on a single shared world map and disease/cube state, coordinating actions toward common objectives rather than competing, so essentially the entire game state is shared and there is no opponent to block or attack. Players plan together and can trade cards with each other (following specific rules on who can trade what), functioning as the game's negotiation element.

scoring.how_you_win: The team wins together by discovering cures for all four diseases before the player deck runs out, outbreaks reach eight, or any disease's cube supply is exhausted.
